title: Acetylation of p53 in the Cerebral Cortex after Photothrombotic Stroke.
authors: Guzenko, V V; Bachurin, S S; Khaitin, A M; Dzreyan, V A; Kalyuzhnaya, Y N; Bin, He; Demyanenko, S V
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脑卒中后p53乙酰化修饰及其在神经元存活中的作用，虽涉及in silico模拟，但核心是蛋白乙酰化而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: p53 expression and acetylation are crucial for the survival and death of neurons in penumbra. At the same time, the outcome of ischemia for penumbra cells depends largely on the histone acetylation status, but the effect of histone acetyltransferases and deacetylases on non-histone proteins like p53 is largely understudied. With combined in silico and in vitro approach, we have identified enzymes capable of acetylation/deacetylation, distribution, stability, and pro-apoptotic activity of p53 in ischemic penumbra in the course of post-stroke recovery, and also detected involved loci of acetylation in p53. The dynamic regulation of the acetylation of p53 at lysine 320 is controlled by acetyltransferase PCAF and histone deacetylases HDAC1 and HDAC6. The in silico simulation have made it possible to suggest the acetylation of p53 at lysine 320 acetylation may facilitate the shuttling of p53 between the nucleus and cytoplasm in penumbra neurons. Acetylation of p53 at lysine 320 is more preferable than acetylation at lysine 373 and probably promotes survival and repair of penumbra neurons after stroke. Strategies to increase p53 acetylation at lysine 320 via increasing PCAF activity, inhibiting HDAC1 or HDAC6, inhibiting p53, or a combination of these interventions may have therapeutic benefits for stroke recovery and would be promising for neuroprotective therapy of stroke.
abstract_zh: p53的表达和乙酰化对于半暗带神经元的存活与死亡至关重要。同时，缺血对半暗带细胞的结果在很大程度上取决于组蛋白乙酰化状态，但组蛋白乙酰转移酶和去乙酰化酶对非组蛋白蛋白如p53的影响在很大程度上尚未被充分研究。通过结合计算机模拟和体外实验方法，我们鉴定了在卒中后恢复过程中，能够对缺血半暗带中的p53进行乙酰化/去乙酰化、分布、稳定性及促凋亡活性调控的酶，并检测了p53中涉及的乙酰化位点。p53在赖氨酸320位点的乙酰化动态调控由乙酰转移酶PCAF和组蛋白去乙酰化酶HDAC1及HDAC6控制。计算机模拟使得提出以下假设成为可能：p53在赖氨酸320位点的乙酰化可能促进半暗带神经元中p53在细胞核与细胞质之间的穿梭。p53在赖氨酸320位点的乙酰化比在赖氨酸373位点的乙酰化更为优选，并可能促进卒中后半暗带神经元的存活与修复。通过增加PCAF活性、抑制HDAC1或HDAC6、抑制p53或这些干预措施的组合来提高p53在赖氨酸320位点的乙酰化策略，可能对卒中恢复具有治疗益处，并有望成为卒中神经保护治疗的 promising 方法。
